$comment: The layout system the console and the desktop panel share. Both repos carry this file; each repo's gate asserts its own stylesheet uses these numbers AND that this file's sha256 matches the literal recorded in the other repo's test. Change it in both repos or neither.

head.$comment: The page HEADER's row, which both surfaces draw (a cut): the title block on the left, its lede or its actions beside it, aligned to the top so a wrapping lede grows downward.

rail.$comment: Each surface's first column. The CONSOLE collapses at `tablet` (767): below it the rail becomes the top bar, so the page's left is 0 — measured at 380/480/639. The PANEL never collapses: it is a device app in a window, and its rail is the page's first column at every width. The widths are recorded rather than equalized; the COLLAPSE is a rule, not a habit.

section.$comment: The levels UNDER a page title (the forty-ninth list). A page has one title and the blocks below it are a LEVEL, not a size chosen per page: `h2` is a section, `h3` is the thing inside one, `eyebrow` is the small uppercase label above a block. Measured before: an h2 was 22, 17, 14 or 10 px depending on the page.

empty.$comment: The EMPTY state's atom, which both surfaces draw (the forty-sixth list). A page with nothing to list shows one card, on the page's own grid: the card's corner and padding, start-aligned text, no shadow, and the full width of the page's column. It is NOT a dialog — a 20px corner, a drop shadow and centred text on a 1120px column is a modal drawn where a page's empty state belongs.

loading.$comment: The LOADING state's atom, which both surfaces draw (the forty-seventh list). A read that has not answered reserves the SHAPE of what it will draw: a card-sized skeleton row per item, with the read's own label in a live region. It is NOT a word in a result line: a loading state is not a result, and the count line is drawn only when it has a count.

failed.$comment: The FAILED state's atom, which both surfaces draw (the forty-eighth list). A failure is a NOTICE: the page's card grammar with the alarm's tint, its words in INK (the sentence is the message; the tint is the alarm), one Retry, and ONE live region — a second region saying the same failure in other words is two announcements.

motion.$comment: Rule 18's mechanism, recorded once for both surfaces (the fifty-second list). REDUCED MOTION IS A BLANKET: every transition and animation is capped at 0.01ms under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, because a NAMED LIST cannot cover a rule added later — measured, the panel still moved 4 elements at 0.2s under reduce while the console moved 0. The named list stays for the second half: an animation whose state must also stop (`animation: none`). `0.01ms` rather than `0s` so a `transitionend` listener still fires.
